To: jan.thornton@mailbox.example
Replying to: none
Cc: pete.thornton@mailbox.example, carol.rigby@mailbox.example
Subject: Caravan 2027 - park bill, shares and weeks

Dear Jan, Pete and Carol,

The park bill for 2027 has come in at £5,087 all in, so that is £1,271.75 each between the four of us. I know it's up about £350 on last year. Nothing I can do about it, the park sets it.

Please can you pay me by 31 January into the usual account, same as last year. The park wants the whole lot by then. If anyone would rather pay in two lots, that's fine. It can be £635.87 in December and £635.88 in January. Just let me know.

The weeks for next year are as follows:

Pete and Linda, 29 May to 5 June, May half term.
Me and Bev, 5 to 12 June, with the handover on the 5th.
Jan, 7 to 14 August.
Carol, Easter week and a week in September.

No clashes this year, so that's everyone sorted.

Pete, the shower tray. I went up on 26 October and put a new one in. It cost £140 in parts. I'm not putting that on the bill, it's done.

Two reminders. When you leave, please turn the water off at the stop tap. The park has moaned about it more than once. Also, caravans over 15 years old will need a condition survey before the 2028 season. Ours is 16 years old, so I'm mentioning it now so nobody's surprised.

Any problems, let me know.

Mick
